typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	TblAllReconDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		EFFDATE as timestamp,
		SYSTEMRECORD as string,
		CUSIP as string,
		TYPE as string,
		PC as string,
		STRIKE as decimal(24,8),
		EXPIRATION as integer,
		STRATEGY as string,
		GROUPNAME as string,
		BOOKNAME as string,
		LEGALENTITY as string,
		RC as string,
		CUSTOMERTYPE as string,
		IMAGINELONGNAME as string,
		HOLDID as integer,
		CURRMARK as decimal(24,8),
		CURRQTY as decimal(24,8),
		CURRMKTVALUSD as decimal(24,8)
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> TblAllReconSource
TblAllReconSource derive(ToAddLoadDate = currentTimestamp()) ~> ToAddLoadDate
ToAddLoadDate sink(input(
		GroupName as string,
		CurrQty as integer,
		LegalEntity as string,
		CurrMark as integer,
		BookName as string,
		Strike as integer,
		Expiration as integer,
		Load_Date as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		EffDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		CustomerType as string,
		Cusip as string,
		ImagineLongName as string,
		RC as string,
		HoldID as integer,
		Type as string,
		PC as string,
		Strategy as string,
		SystemRecord as string,
		CurrMktValUsd as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		GroupName = GROUPNAME,
		CurrQty = CURRQTY,
		LegalEntity = LEGALENTITY,
		CurrMark = CURRMARK,
		BookName = BOOKNAME,
		Strike = STRIKE,
		Expiration = EXPIRATION,
		Load_Date = ToAddLoadDate,
		EffDate = EFFDATE,
		CustomerType = CUSTOMERTYPE,
		Cusip = CUSIP,
		ImagineLongName = IMAGINELONGNAME,
		RC,
		HoldID = HOLDID,
		Type = TYPE,
		PC,
		Strategy = STRATEGY,
		SystemRecord = SYSTEMRECORD,
		CurrMktValUsd = CURRMKTVALUSD),
	partitionFileNames:[($TblAllReconDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> TblAllReconDestination
